# CHANGELOG for firmware release v154 — target esp32c3
## ✨ New Features
* Added support for Matter protocol over Wi-Fi on ESP32C3
* Implemented device discovery using ESP-NOW protocol
* Enhanced LED control using PWM signals

## 🐛 Bug Fixes
* Fixed issue with incorrect Wi-Fi channel selection on ESP32C3
* Resolved bug causing occasional device restarts during BLE connections
* Corrected ADC reading errors on certain ESP32C3 pins

## 🔐 Security
* Identified 1 secret in the codebase, which will be addressed in the next release
* No critical CVEs detected in this release
* Security score remains at 0/10, indicating a need for improvement

## ⚡ Performance
* Optimized flash usage, now at 43.9% of total capacity
* Potential saving of 95 KB identified for future optimization
* Improved device boot time by reducing unnecessary initialization steps

## 🔍 Code Quality
* Generated 4 new tests to improve code coverage
* No AI patches applied in this release, but will be considered for future updates
* Code quality metrics will be tracked and improved in subsequent releases

## ✅ Quality Gates
* Build process completed successfully
* No patches applied in this release, but will be evaluated for future updates
* Quality gates will be enforced more strictly in future releases

## ⚠️ Known Issues
* Security score remains a concern, with a score of 0/10
* One secret was detected in the codebase, which needs to be addressed
* Device may still experience occasional restarts during heavy network usage

## 🔜 Next Release
* Address the identified secret in the codebase
* Improve security score by implementing additional security measures
* Apply AI patches to further optimize performance and code quality
